title: RecipeParameters
description: One file per site (params/omniverse2.yaml, params/production.yaml). Every site-specific value is a named parameter; secrets are referenced by name only (FR-018).

secret_ref.description: true: value is the NAME of a secret, never the secret

confirmed.description: false: production value awaits the platform team

production_value.description: documented in the omniverse2 file next to each value (SC-008)

not_proven_here.description: production properties this site's build does not prove (precision, scale, virtualisation stand-in)
